question: Which permission-set groups have not reached Updated status?

steps.name: groups
steps.soql: SELECT DeveloperName, MasterLabel, Status, LastModifiedDate FROM PermissionSetGroup WHERE Status != 'Updated' ORDER BY LastModifiedDate DESC LIMIT {limit}

verdicts.say: {groups.rows} row(s) returned by the first query. Review selected columns, query limits and follow-up steps; this is not an org-wide assessment.

traps: Status describes an export-time snapshot. Calculation may complete after the query.
Effective permissions also depend on muting, assignment and other grants.
